class.name: CbShowKey
class.brief_description: Shows a node while a key is held, or switches it with each press. A scoreboard on Tab, a map on M.
class.description: Put it under the node to show (its [member target] is its parent unless you say otherwise). The target starts hidden. The key is an action of the viewer's own: the server and the simulation never hear of it, so it costs none of a server's actions. The first node that names an [member action] gives it its default [member key]; from then on it is one of the game's keys, [code]{key:scores}[/code] in a format shows what it is bound to, and rebinding moves it. Looks only: what a key shows is up to the scene. A key that [i]does[/i] something in the game is an action a server mod declares.

members.member: The key's name, one word. Two nodes with the same action share the key.
The key it has until the player binds another, as Godot writes keys: [code]Tab[/code], [code]M[/code], [code]F1[/code], [code]Space[/code].
Shown while the key is down, or switched by each press.
Expressions that must hold too ([code]!?deathmatch.score[/code]: step aside when a game mode brings its own scoreboard).

constants.constant: Shown while the key is held.
Each press shows or hides it.
